podcast.title: Cousin to Jerry Lee Lewis
podcast.body: Jimmy Swaggart was Jerry Lee Lewis's double-first cousin, with Swaggart's father being Lewis's father's nephew and Swaggart's mother being Lewis's mother's sister. "Swaggot's father was Lewis's father's nephew, while Swaggot's mother was Lewis's mother's sister."

podcast.title: Pentecostal Upbringing and Rebellion
podcast.body: As a child, Jimmy Swaggart was once dragged to the cinema by his cousin Jerry Lee Lewis, an act considered a sin in their strict Pentecostal religion, leading Swaggart to run out crying, convinced he had "damned himself to hell." "one time he dragged in Jimmy Swaggot, who was his double-first cousin."
